method: First-pass visual inventory of main occupation/industry fields on all 87 population sheets of EDs 10-8, 10-9 and 10-10. One industry-only row is retained separately from occupation counts. Supplementary-only prior jobs excluded. These are schedule appearances, not deduplicated employed people, labor-force rates, private-household counts or establishments. Residence is not workplace. Head anchors are provisional; hotel groups and individual census reports need reconciliation before household statistics. Normalized readings, not diplomatic transcription. Worker class is copied but not used to infer industry or work status.
